title: 第29章
content:
江南三中的公告栏前挤满了学生，盛夏的蝉鸣混着此起彼伏的议论声，热浪般扑面而来。林宇站在人群外围，望着电子屏上滚动的模拟考成绩。榜单从第二名开始依次排列，却始终不见他的名字。“我就说林宇是个骗子！”赵天雷的声音从人群中传来，带着毫不掩饰的得意。他挤到前排，指着空白的榜首位置，“看看，做贼心虚不敢露面了吧？”人群顿时骚动起来，窃窃私语声像潮水般涌来。“听说他交的答卷全是乱写的，根本看不懂。”“就是，肯定是想博眼球，没想到露馅了。”林宇皱起眉头，正要上前理论，忽然瞥见赵天雷嘴角那抹阴笑。他注意到赵天雷手中紧握着一支修正液，指节因为用力而微微发白。就在这时，教务处主任张建国匆匆赶来，拨开人群，脸色阴沉得可怕。“赵天雷，跟我到教务处一趟！”他的声音冰冷，带着不容置疑的威严。赵天雷脸色瞬间变得惨白，手中的修正液“啪嗒”掉在地上。“张主任，您这是什么意思？”他强装镇定，声音却有些发颤。“装什么糊涂！”张建国怒喝一声，“监控已经拍到你篡改成绩，还不老实交代！”人群顿时炸开了锅，所有人都震惊地看着赵天雷。林宇也愣住了，他没想到赵天雷竟然这么大胆，敢公然篡改成绩。就在这时，电子屏突然闪烁起来，紧接着，一段二进制代码快速滚动，最终化作一张试卷的扫描图。那正是林宇的答卷，右下角赫然标注着“国安局第7处已备案”。全场一片死寂，只有蝉鸣声依旧刺耳。赵天雷的脸色变得死灰，双腿一软，险些瘫倒在地。他无论如何也没想到，自己精心策划的一切，竟然这么快就败露了。苏清影站在人群中，心跳得飞快。她拿出手机，想要拍下这一幕，却发现相册里不知何时多了一张照片——正是林宇答卷上被系统修正的关键参数。她感到一阵寒意，下意识地看向林宇，却发现他正盯着电子屏，眼神中带着一丝若有所思。“这不可能...”赵天雷喃喃自语，“怎么会这样...”“带走！”张建国一挥手，两名保安上前，架起失魂落魄的赵天雷。就在这时，校门口突然传来一阵骚动。几辆黑色轿车驶入校园，荷枪实弹的士兵迅速包围了公告栏。人群惊恐地散开，不知道发生了什么事。一名身着军装的少校走下车，大步流星地来到林宇面前，敬了个标准的军礼：“林宇同学，国安局第七处奉命带你回总部接受调查。”林宇还没反应过来，就被士兵们护送上了车。轿车呼啸而去，只留下目瞪口呆的众人。车内，林宇看着窗外飞速后退的景色，心跳不由自主地加快。他知道，自己的人生即将迎来翻天覆地的变化。系统在脑海中无声地运转，似乎在预示着什么。国安局总部，一间密封的审讯室内。林宇坐在冰冷的金属椅子上，对面坐着三名表情严肃的调查员。“林宇，如实交代你是如何获取六代机核心技术的？”为首的调查员目光如炬，声音低沉。

林宇深吸一口气，决定赌一把：“我...我有一个系统，可以解析任何科技蓝图。那天的试卷，就是系统帮我完成的。”调查员们对视一眼，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。他们显然没想到会得到这样的回答。“荒谬！”一名调查员拍案而起，“你以为我们会相信这种鬼话？”林宇没有辩解，只是静静地看着他们。系统适时地在他脑海中弹出提示：“检测到怀疑情绪，建议进行现场演示。”“我可以现场演示给你们看。”林宇突然开口。调查员们愣住了，面面相觑。最终，为首的调查员点点头：“好，给你一个机会。如果你敢耍花样，后果你承担不起。”很快，一份关于新型雷达系统的机密资料摆在了林宇面前。林宇闭上眼睛，启动系统。顿时，无数数据流在他脑海中涌现，复杂的技术原理变得清晰易懂。十分钟后，林宇睁开眼睛，拿起笔，在白纸上飞速书写起来。他不仅详细解析了现有雷达系统的缺陷，还提出了一套基于量子纠缠原理的改良方案。调查员们围拢过来，看着纸上的内容，脸色逐渐变得凝重。这些理论他们并非不懂，但如此大胆创新的思路，却是他们从未想过的。“这...这怎么可能...”一名调查员喃喃自语。就在这时，审讯室的门突然被推开，一位白发苍苍的老者走了进来。林宇定睛一看，竟然是国家科学院院长王鸿远。“王院长！”调查员们纷纷敬礼。王鸿远摆摆手，目光紧紧盯着林宇：“孩子，你的答卷我看过了，简直是天才之作！”他顿了顿，“不过，这个系统的事情，还需要进一步验证。”林宇点点头，心中却松了一口气。至少，他暂时取得了他们的信任。与此同时，赵天雷被关在另一间审讯室内。他的手机突然震动起来，是一条来自境外的匿名短信：“任务失败，立即启动b计划。”赵天雷看着短信，眼中闪过一丝狠厉。他知道，自己不能坐以待毙，必须想办法翻盘。而此时，他还不知道，他的家族已经因为他的愚蠢行为，陷入了万劫不复的境地。国安局的调查仍在继续，而林宇的命运，也在这一刻发生了巨大的转折。等待他的，将是更加神秘的未来，以及前所未有的挑战。在江南三中，关于林宇的议论仍在继续。苏清影望着林宇离去的方向，心中涌起一股莫名的担忧。她总觉得，这一切背后，似乎隐藏着一个巨大的秘密。夜幕降临，城市的灯火次第亮起。林宇站在国安局的窗前，看着窗外的繁华景象，思绪万千。系统在他脑海中不断推送着各种科技信息，仿佛在为他指引着方向。突然，系统发出一阵急促的警报声：“检测到未知能量波动，距离20公里，正在快速接近！”林宇心中一紧，他知道，真正的挑战，才刚刚开始...
content_en:
The bulletin board of Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School was crowded with students. The chirping of cicadas in the midsummer was mixed with the sound of discussions, and it was like a heat wave.Lin Yu stood on the periphery of the crowd, looking at the mock test results scrolling on the electronic screen.The list was arranged in order starting from second place, but his name was never seen."I just said Lin Yu is a liar!" Zhao Tianlei's voice came from the crowd, with undisguised pride.He squeezed into the front row and pointed to the empty top spot, "Look, are you too guilty of a thief to show up?" The crowd suddenly became commotion, and whispers came in like a tide."I heard that the answer sheets he handed in were all scrawled and couldn't be understood at all." "That's right, he must be trying to gain attention, but he didn't expect the secret to be revealed." Lin Yu frowned and was about to step forward to argue when he suddenly caught a glimpse of the sinister smile on the corner of Zhao Tianlei's mouth.He noticed that Zhao Tianlei was holding a bottle of correction fluid tightly in his hand, and his knuckles were slightly white from the exertion.At this moment, Zhang Jianguo, director of the Academic Affairs Office, hurried over and pushed aside the crowd, his face terrifyingly gloomy."Zhao Tianlei, come with me to the Academic Affairs Office!" His voice was cold and filled with unquestionable majesty.Zhao Tianlei's face instantly turned pale, and the correction fluid in his hand fell to the ground with a clatter."Director Zhang, what do you mean?" He pretended to be calm, but his voice was trembling."Why are you pretending to be confused!" Zhang Jianguo shouted angrily, "The surveillance has caught you tampering with your scores, why don't you tell the truth!" The crowd immediately exploded, and everyone looked at Zhao Tianlei in shock.Lin Yu was also stunned. He didn't expect Zhao Tianlei to be so bold and dare to openly tamper with the results.At this moment, the electronic screen suddenly flashed, and then, a piece of binary code scrolled rapidly, and finally turned into a scan of the test paper.That was Lin Yu's answer sheet, with "Registered at Division 7 of the National Security Bureau" clearly marked in the lower right corner.The whole place was dead silent, except for the shrill chirping of cicadas.Zhao Tianlei's face turned ashen, his legs went weak, and he almost collapsed to the ground.He never expected that everything he had carefully planned would be exposed so quickly.Su Qingying stood in the crowd, her heart beating fast.She took out her mobile phone and wanted to take a picture of this scene, but found that there was an extra photo in the album at some point - it was the key parameter that was corrected by the system on Lin Yu's answer sheet.She felt a chill and subconsciously looked at Lin Yu, only to find that he was staring at the electronic screen with a hint of thoughtfulness in his eyes."This is impossible..." Zhao Tianlei murmured to himself, "How could this happen..." "Take away!" Zhang Jianguo waved his hand, and two security guards stepped forward to lift up the distraught Zhao Tianlei.At this moment, there was a sudden commotion at the school gate.Several black cars drove into the campus, and soldiers with loaded ammunition quickly surrounded the bulletin board.The crowd dispersed in horror, wondering what was happening.A major in military uniform stepped out of the car, strode up to Lin Yu, and gave a standard military salute: "Classmate Lin Yu, the Seventh Division of the National Security Bureau has been ordered to take you back to the headquarters for investigation." Before Lin Yu could react, he was escorted into the car by soldiers.The car roared away, leaving only the stunned people.In the car, Lin Yu looked at the rapidly receding scenery outside the window, and his heartbeat accelerated involuntarily.He knew that his life was about to undergo earth-shaking changes.The system was running silently in my mind, as if it was foreshadowing something.National Security Bureau headquarters, a sealed interrogation room.Lin Yu sat on a cold metal chair, with three serious-looking investigators sitting opposite him."Lin Yu, tell the truth how you obtained the core technology of the sixth-generation machine?" The leading investigator's eyes were sharp and his voice was low.

Lin Yu took a deep breath and decided to take a gamble: "I...I have a system that can analyze any technological blueprint. The system helped me complete the test paper that day." The investigators looked at each other with a trace of surprise in their eyes.They obviously didn't expect such an answer."Absurd!" an investigator shouted, "Do you think we would believe such nonsense?" Lin Yu did not defend himself, but just looked at them quietly.The system promptly popped up a prompt in his mind: "Suspicion detected, it is recommended to conduct a live demonstration." "I can give you a live demonstration." Lin Yu suddenly said.The investigators were stunned and looked at each other.Finally, the leading investigator nodded: "Okay, I'll give you a chance. If you dare to play tricks, you can't afford the consequences." Soon, a piece of confidential information about a new radar system was placed in front of Lin Yu.Lin Yu closed his eyes and started the system.Suddenly, countless data streams emerged in his mind, and complex technical principles became clear and easy to understand.Ten minutes later, Lin Yu opened his eyes, picked up a pen, and started writing quickly on the white paper.He not only analyzed the shortcomings of the existing radar system in detail, but also proposed an improvement plan based on the principle of quantum entanglement.The investigators gathered around and looked at the contents on the paper, their expressions gradually becoming serious.It's not that they don't understand these theories, but such bold and innovative ideas are something they have never thought of."This...how is this possible..." one of the investigators muttered.At this moment, the door of the interrogation room was suddenly pushed open, and a gray-haired old man walked in.Lin Yu took a closer look and saw that it was Wang Hongyuan, the president of the National Academy of Sciences."Dean Wang!" The investigators saluted.Wang Hongyuan waved his hand and stared at Lin Yu: "Child, I have read your answer sheet. It is a work of genius!" He paused, "However, this system needs further verification." Lin Yu nodded, feeling relieved.At least he temporarily gained their trust.At the same time, Zhao Tianlei was locked in another interrogation room.His phone suddenly vibrated with an anonymous text message from abroad: "Mission failed, start plan B immediately." Zhao Tianlei looked at the text message with a fierce look in his eyes.He knew that he couldn't sit still and wait for death, he had to find a way to make a comeback.At this time, he didn't know that his family had fallen into a desperate situation because of his stupid behavior.The National Security Bureau's investigation is still continuing, and Lin Yu's fate also took a huge turn at this moment.What awaits him will be a more mysterious future and unprecedented challenges.In Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School, discussions about Lin Yu continue.Su Qingying looked at the direction Lin Yu was leaving, feeling an inexplicable worry in her heart.She always felt that there seemed to be a huge secret hidden behind all this.As night falls, the lights of the city light up one after another.Lin Yu stood in front of the window of the National Security Bureau, looking at the bustling scene outside the window, with a lot of thoughts.The system continuously pushed various technological information in his mind, as if guiding him in the direction.Suddenly, the system sent out a rapid alarm: "Unknown energy fluctuations detected, 20 kilometers away, approaching quickly!" Lin Yu's heart tightened, and he knew that the real challenge had just begun...
